To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) selection for 8 wk BW was as effective in the presence of altered water to feed ratio as it was in a normal water to feed ratio and 2) the heritability for 8 wk body weight was not influenced by the altered water to feed environment.

selection for 6-wk BW under three different water to feed ratios (high salt, normal salt, low salt) was as effective as selection under the normal salt diet and resulted in heritabilities of BW ranging from.38 to 46.

selection for 6-wk BW was effective under selection environments that included high- and low-water to feed ratios and that realized heritabilities of BW were similar across these selection environments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of selection on growth and body composition traits in two chicken populations.
the response to selection under different water to feed ratios in two randombred lines and the effects of selection on the growth curve of the chicken.
the response to selection under altered water to diet ratios.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the heritability for BW in chickens was not affected by the dietary salt levels used in this study.
heritabilities for 8-wkbw were relatively constant across generations and selection response patterns were very similar across the three dietary salt environments.
selection for 1-wk BW is as effective as selection for 8- wk BW, and the realized heritabilities for 1-w and 8-wk body weight are approximately equal.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
selection for 7-wk BW in the AC and AR populations was effective under three different dietary salt levels.
heritabilities were similar for both populations and were not influenced by dietary salt.
the response to selection was not affected by dietary salt levels.
The main takeaway from our work is that
selection for 80-d body weight is as effective under a high salt selection environment as under a normal or a low salt selection environment.
selection response for BW was similar in lines fed a high-salt or a low-salt diet.
the response to selection was similar across all three selection environments, which suggests that selection can be conducted in a wide range of environmental conditions.
